description: This Dart source file defines a Flutter widget for displaying a list of saved news articles, supporting navigation to read individual articles and deletion of saved articles with confirmation dialogs.

classes.name: SavedNewsScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that displays a list of saved news articles with options to view or delete them.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the UI for the SavedNewsScreen, showing either a message if no saved news or a list of saved articles.

methods.name: _open
methods.description: Navigates to the ReadArticleScreen to display the selected news article.

methods.name: _confirmDelete
methods.description: Shows a confirmation dialog and deletes the article from saved articles if confirmed.
